summary.en: Indie-label autonomy and post-2000 guitar revival on radio and streaming.
summary.zh: 独立厂牌自治，与 2000 年后电台/流媒体上的吉他复兴。

body.en: Indie Rock prizes label autonomy, local scenes, and flexible song forms. The 2000s–2010s UK and North American revivals put Arctic Monkeys and peers back on the chronicle axis with garage edge and pop hooks.
body.zh: Indie Rock 强调厂牌自治、本地场景与曲式弹性。2000s–2010s 英国与北美复兴，让 Arctic Monkeys 等乐队用车库锋利与流行钩子重新写进编年主轴。
